title: SSE unfold: comment the scan_from UTF-8 invariant at the invariant site
description: In client.rs subscribe_events, the invariant that scan_from must be a valid UTF-8 char boundary is guarded by a while-loop at line 341, but the while-loop comment says 'Walk backward to a valid UTF-8 char boundary so that buf[scan_from..] never panics on multibyte characters.' — the invariant is documented at the enforcement point but not at the two other places that set scan_from (the initial 0usize in SseStreamState and the reset to 0 after consuming a frame). A contributor adding a new scan_from assignment path would have no cue that the invariant applies there too. Add a short type-level comment on SseStreamState.scan_from explaining the invariant it must satisfy.
